notes.title: Arcadian Days pre-release post
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone, I am beyond excited + a little nervous to finally release Arcadian days in Early Access! We have build quite a number of wishlists without much, if any, marketing budget, and almost the entire game has been solo made by me, with some amazing support from freelancers for some models and gameplay elements. We have a new trailer available I hope you enjoy, it doesn't reveal much as Arcadian Days is a game full of secrets and discoveries that I want players to find. I will however try to answer now some questions for you : 
[/p][h3][b]
What is the actual loop of Arcadian Days? Is it a farming sim?
[/b][/h3][p]Arcadian Days is an adventure and exploration game that is highly quest and character driven. You will spend your time exploring, completing quests and making discoveries, each aimed to be designed to be interesting, unique and most importantly related to each other. Every quest and element in Arcadian Days will influence other elements in some way or another.[/p][p]It is not a farming sim or a crafting game, and those are elements that will probably not be introduced as I want the narrative and discovery to be the main focus as well as allow the game to stand on its own amongst a sea of cozy crafting and farming sims! [/p][p]I hope the story we are crafting for you will be enjoyable and you will greatly enjoy discovering this world, completing the quests and watching how your actions influence the narrative and the world. [/p][p]As we release more updates, there will be more to come to expand the story in some very interesting ways. however for the initial run of Early Access we will focus on getting to know the characters and the world of Arcadian Days. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]How long will the game be in its current state?[/b][/h3][p]The aim is for Arcadian Days to be an open world adventure game that respects your time, with diverse and well thought out quests, with a lot of replayability as the branching storyline expands. The current state of Early Access can be anywhere between 3 to 6 hours depending on how quick one moves and wanting to discover everything, with much more quests and content to come regularly.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]What is the roadmap for Arcadian Days? [/b][/h3][p]I will reveal a proper roadmap very shortly after release as I analyze the data, however rest assured there is currently a VERY clear roadmap ahead and all major updates have already been planned. Depending on the success of Early Access and community engagement, I want to hire more people full time to assist in developing this world. [/p][p]I am excited to reveal a big update will already come [b]next week [/b]that will add even more quests and adventures as well as a quest chain related to the fuzzy sheep of Bucuria. As i have been quite ill the past month it was hard to prepare all the quests but they are coming very shortly and I hope regularly. [/p][p]Things to look forward to in future updates include :[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]An expanded storyline that aims to be wholesome, hearth-warming and have a touch of mystery and supernatural. Lots of diverse and fun side quests and activities as well!
[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded customisation of the household and characters, with players having a more direct role in the way the homestead can be customised as well as what the characters wear, all of course quest related in fun ways![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Tola the dog companion, who will be with you and help you with quests and also have interactions. The aim is to have one of the best dog companions in a game every, where Tola is not just an extension of the main character but its own being for players to connect with and grow. [/p][/*][*][p]More environments to explore which aim to be unique and never seen before including a river Delta, a majestic valley unlike any other and an ancient fortress on top of a forested hill. [/p][/*][*][p]Some new NPCs, new ways to interact with your family and a late game storyline where the player will choose the vocation the Dragobete family will follow, whether they wish to focus on animal husbandry, textiles or even fishing![/p][/*][*][p]The Mocanitza - Can't say much about this one yet but I will leave a clue : 🚂[/p][/*][*][p]Community requests and features, I can't wait to hear your ideas and see what we can implement![/p][/*][*][p]Localization and Steam Achievements ![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Can we expect a lot of bugs and performance issues?[/b][/h3][p]Hopefully you shouldn't even for an Early Access game! A lot of time has been spent to ensure there are no game breaking bugs, there might be a few glitches and placeholders here and there which please do let us know so we can fix asap! 
I know Unreal Engine 5 has quite a reputation but I tried really hard to ensure it is as well optimised as possible, however I haven't had a chance to test on lower end computers, so please do let us know how the game runs for you and your specs, the optimisation of the game will be a constant work and I want to ensure the game runs very very well.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]If you have any more questions, please do let me know, and feel free to join our discord using the links below as well as following our socials. Please do use the community features for any bugs, performance issues or just general questions, I will follow those closely and look forward to connecting with you all. 

I can't wait to meet you all in Bucuria and continue on this journey, I appreciate all your support so far!

- Cal, Game Developer of Arcadian Days[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="95g5UJMSkSA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Arcadian Days releasing 26.09.2025
notes.content:
[p]Hello friends, [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you very much to all for supporting and following my little indie game so far! [/p][p][/p][p]Due to some unfortunate health issues, I have had to delay the release of the game to the 26th of September! This 10 day delay will allow me to recuperate and deliver the final polish and quests for the game releases.

Although I am aware it is an Early Access release, I want it to be as bug free, polished and optimized as possible for you. To make up for this, the game will release with a 15% discount for the first week! [/p][p][/p][p]Your support will help us continue to expand the game in wonderful ways that will be laid out in the roadmap shortly after release, so please buy the game and spread the word to your fellow gamers and friends. [/p][p][/p][p]Expect very soon an exciting launch trailer and previews of the game as we approach the 26th!

I greatly appreciate your patience and look forward to seeing you all in Bucuria on the 26th!

   -  Cal[/p]

notes.title: How Arcadian Days plays - Early Access coming 16.09.2025
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone, as we are gearing up for release in Early Access very soon, I would like to write here a little dev log on how the game will play and the core loop which I hope will clarify a lot of things! I am trying not to reveal too much as I want players to discover as much as possible for themselves! 

We are also working on a launch trailer that will be the most gameplay focused. [/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]Arcadian Days is a non-linear, character driven exploration game.[/u][/b] [/h3][p]On a surface level, Arcadian Days might seem like a farming or survival crafting game, however this is not the case. There are no plans to include crafting or farming sim elements. Everything in Arcadian Days is driven entirely through hand-crafted quests and adventures you can partake in and discover at your own pace, with some light puzzle elements. As you go through quests, you can see the homestead be developed, new decorations added and new adventures unlocked. I want players to adventure as much as possible and discover in Arcadian Days, which goes with the theme of playing as a child. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555316/712afa4c23db9c0f418771b59cb9883edc709a68.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]Narrative LEGOs and reactive world full of dynamic encounters.[/u][/b] [/h3][p]I took a lot of inspiration Ken Levine, director Bioshock and Bioshock Infinite on how to use 'Narrative LEGOs' to create more exciting stories that focus on player agency! 
[/p][p]The world of Arcadian Days offers a thundering amount of narrative possibilities. As Miela is a young child, her development and learning of the world lies in the hand of you, the players. [/p][p][/p][p]The way you solve quest, discover them and even collectibles are all interconnected and have different ramifications. As we go through Early Access, this system will expand to include an affinity system with your family and eventually with your loyal companion, Tola. 

The engaging storyline of Arcadian Days is being specifically written to allow for this branching and dynamic narrative building.  We want every story to feel different for each player. 

For example, the players can develop a sheep pasture in one of the maps if they find enough necessary materials, but those materials can only be discovered based on helping your father build himself a little logging cabin. This will in turn create new quests such as finding lost sheep and further development of the pasture to start a quest chain relating to wool threading to help the family develop their vocation. Of course, the player might not want to build a log cabin and instead focus on forest growth, which will have its own ramifications. The world is designed to be as reactive as possible. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555316/633ca6c4fcbe17bdc2bada71cd45535dbc02ee8d.png"][/img]
[/p][h3][b][u]Immersive, minimalist interface and gameplay.[/u][/b]
[/h3][p]I want the players to enjoy the exploration and discovery elements to the fullest. [/p][p]Arcadian Days features a highly minimalist HUD and gameplay, where we aim to have actions and interactions happen in a diegetic, fun way with exciting player feedback. [/p][p]Due to the sandbox and non-linear approach, there is no quest log in Arcadian Days, and we have a number of fun ways for players to find their ways around and progress : [/p][list][*][p]Context Thoughts - At the press of a button, Miela will think out loud about where they are and what can be done in any given area. Those Context Thoughts are both location and quest sensitive, so they will always be different. The Context Thoughts button will have a cool down and I heavily encourage players to not make too much use of it so they can discover at their own pace with their curiosity. [/p][/*][*][p]Talk to your parents - In Arcadian Days, you parents are there to guide you and help. Speaking to them can help you progress specific quests and adventures as well as give you a helping hand. [/p][/*][*][p]Inventory Items - each item in the inventory will have a description that can help you know what to do with it. Items are unique and each related to something you can do whilst exploring the land of Bucuria. [/p][/*][/list][p]The player should never feel stuck in Arcadian Days, as even when it seems like you might have hit a road-block, exploration and creative thinking can help you progress. You can always return to something at a later time as very few quests are time-restricted. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555316/b5c3c17eb1787de14045fa1afcc14b94d906d36d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555316/0c42d4792460177aee45af84faeb875821af68de.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Cinematic presentation in a world we want you to believe exists.[/h3][p]Arcadian Days aims to be a highly cinematic, beautiful adventure set in a thoroughly build world. [/p][p]Besides featuring AAA graphics and sound design to further the immersion, you will encounter cinematic cutscenes build using my experience and passion in filmmaking. We want however to keep both cutscenes and dialogue to a minimum where possible as gameplay is front and centre in Arcadian Days. [/p][p]The world of Bucuria is inspired by Romanian Landscapes and Cultures which are almost never seen in any type of media with plenty of creative liberties to create a truly original world. You will discover a lot of terms and history around that you have the opportunity to learn about. [/p][p]We want players to really believe Bucuria is a real place and be fascinated to discover its history and how it relates to Miela and the Dragobete family. [/p][p]You can also expect some light folk and mythology as the narrative progresses throughout Early Access. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555316/597e7749f770357d082458a45dba4609243bb19a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555316/b1c165329d213641736e1edc9283a2010eee385b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555316/d08ce509efcf92dcfc5dc38a2183bcd9ce4a19ff.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Of course, there is much more to see in Arcadian Days and we cannot wait to share it all with you on the 16th of September and watch this world grow together. [/p][p][/p][p]If you ever have any curiosities and questions do reach and please follow our socials for more! 

Until then, have a lovely day! 

   - Cal[/p]

notes.title: Arcadian Days Steam Next Fest Demo Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! 

Unfortunately I couldn't quite release as big of an update for Steam Next Fest as I wished as I was very inconveniently hit by a bad case of the Flu, however I still have plenty for you :) [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Performance should be massively improved across lots of devices + Steam Deck playability.[/p][/*][*][p]Small dialogue tree for the parents that can help guide you towards events and interesting things in the explorable zone. [/p][/*][*][p]Tutorials added in the journal that will explain some of the concepts such as building and collecting resources. [/p][/*][*][p]Ending to the demo is now available when you reach Zuzuiata Hills. [/p][/*][*][p]The corn field can be explored and features its own challenges in finding the corn basket! [/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes, particularly revolving around the UI. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]There will be even more updates coming throughout the week as I catch up to my work, however I hope you are enjoying the demo so far and as always please leave your feedback regarding performance, bugs and features in general via the Arcadian Days forum or by joining our Discord! It would also mean the world if you enjoy the Demo and recommend it to your friends to play. [/p][p][/p][p]Looking forward to continuing to share more from the world of Arcadian Days![/p][p]- Cal, Game Developer of Arcadian Days[/p]

notes.title: Arcadian Days - Smooth Butter Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

Thank you all for the feedback on the demo so far, particularly regarding performance! You will also notice a slightly smaller disk size.

Having done some under the hood work, I am hoping this new update will significantly improve performance for you! You should now be able to play most of the demo at a steady 60 FPS even on Very High settings, however I have seen that the game looks just as gorgeous on High, so make sure to choose the option that suits you best! 

The Zuzuiata Hills section still sees some drops particularly near the Sheep and the campfire but should still maintain a framerate close to 60 FPS without noticeable drops, however as it is the main open map the performance will be consistently looked into to improve. 

I am very grateful to you all for letting me know about your performance woes and it is very important for me that Arcadian Days can be enjoyed by as many of you as possible. 

As always, please let me know how the performance is and any feedback. 

I look forward to sharing with you all the content update for Steam Next Fest! 

- Cal, Developer of Arcadian Days

notes.title: Arcadian Days Demo - Little Steps Patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

I am overwhelmed by the love for the Arcadian Days Demo so far, we have had lots of players already starting to explore Bucuria! 

A big content patch will come on the 8th just in time for Steam Next Fest, but until then we have released a small patch that should : 

- Improve performance 
- Fix the visual glitch where Miela's hair was in the wrong place in a cutscene. 
- Added additional foliage and decorations of the house. 
- Fix some issues where the game wouldn't transition when interacting with the cart. 

I am currently aware that the FPS limit setting and mouse sensitivity isn't working properly, actively looking into it.

Please do leave your feedback or report bugs by joining our discord, dropping a message on the forums or emailing at calin@immersivgames.com

Arcadian Days is a mostly solo effort but I aim to deliver a polished and wholesome experience for all! 

- Cal, Game Director of Arcadian Days

notes.title: Arcadian Days Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]🌿 The Arcadian Days Alpha Demo is here! 🌿[/h1]

I’m incredibly excited to finally share the first playable piece of Arcadian Days with you — a relaxing and heartfelt Alpha Demo, now available!

This project is deeply personal — a passion I've been developing almost entirely solo — and I truly hope it resonates with you. At its core, Arcadian Days is a gentle invitation to rediscover the world through the eyes of a child: full of wonder, optimism, and the quiet magic of everyday life.

[h2]🌼 What’s in the demo?[/h2]
You’ll get up to 30 minutes of cozy exploration, some light lore-building, and a small taste of the gameplay systems that will grow over time. You’ll explore the tutorial area and two early environments from the game, offering a glimpse into the evolving world of Arcadian Days.

But this is only the beginning.

[h2]✨ What’s Coming in June ✨[/h2]
📅 June 8 – Major Pre-Steam Next Fest Update

[list]
[*] New character animations and cutscenes
[*] 
[*] A proper mini-conclusion to the demo
[*] 
[*] Lusher environments with richer foliage (optimized with your feedback!)
[*] 
[*] Fully interactive dialogue trees with your family
[*] 
[*] First quests, hidden discoveries, and secrets
[*] 
[*] More immersive audio design
[*] 
[*] Expanded lore and world-building
[/list]

[h2]📅 Late June – Second Big Update[/h2]

[list]
[*] Slightly expanded play areas with new content
[*] 
[*] Improved world-building animations and cinematics
[*] 
[*] A more developed opening and ending
[*] 
[*] Player-driven choices that begin to shape the world around you
[/list]

This is a community-built demo. Your feedback will directly shape the direction of the game, and I hope this evolving slice encourages you to return as new content is added.

[h2]🫶 Join our journey:[/h2]
Hop onto our Discord and socials to report bugs, suggest features, or just hang out with us — the creators and the growing Arcadian Days community.

Thank you for being part of this moment. I can’t wait to build something truly special with you all.

With all my heart,
— Cal, Creator of Arcadian Days

notes.content:
